name: Beach sand
where: Tan sand mounds on the south shore of the lake, just ahead of where you start

name: Quartz sand
where: White crystal clusters on the rim of the gorge, north-west behind the west row of halls

name: Iron ore
where: Dark rust-flecked rocks on the rim of the gorge, west of the lake near the waterfall, and more at the top of the west slope

name: Copper ore
where: Plain grey rocks on the west slope, west below the clock tower, and more just west of the library. Look at one with your hand lens (F) to find out what it is

name: Plant oil
where: Sunflowers in the middle of the quad lawn, south-west of the lake. Look at a sunflower seed with a compound microscope (F) to find the oil

name: Tungsten ore
where: Heavy grey rocks at the foot of the west slope, far to the west. Look at one with a high-quality microscope (F) to see what is inside

name: Resin
where: Amber-dripping stumps among the pines on the lower west slope, south-west

name: Fluorite
where: Purple-veined rocks on the gorge rim, west of the quartz crystals. Look at one with a high-quality microscope at 400× (F) to spot the tiny purple cubes

name: Willemite
where: Pale green rocks on the creek bank at the bottom of the gorge. Look at one with the fluorescence microscope in fluorescence mode (F) to see it glow

name: Monazite sand
where: Dark heavy sand on the creek bank at the bottom of the gorge. Take a bit to the transmission electron microscope and record its electron diffraction

name: Beryl
where: Pale six-sided crystals at the foot of the west slope, north of the heavy grey rocks. Take a bit to the STEM and image it with ptychography

name: Galena
where: Heavy silver-grey cubes on the gorge rim, east of the iron rocks near the waterfall

name: Iodine stain
where: The reagent shelf by the west door of the science lab

name: Methylene blue
where: The reagent shelf by the west door of the science lab

name: Gram stain kit
where: The reagent shelf by the west door of the science lab
